title: CONVERT: one 1-ULP drift, one degenerate control, and a self-declared overfit 1/1
upstream_status_verbatim: Unit-conversion factor drift, `1` ULP at `CONVERT(1,"m","ft")`; `CONVERT(1,"in","m")` is an exact control.
status_plain: CONVERT's only counted evidence is the two-row 2026-07-10 reconnaissance corpus, which is one of only two version-controlled corpora in the whole harvest. One row drifts by 1 ULP (CONVERT(1,"m","ft")) and one matches (CONVERT(1,"in","m")) - and the source itself says the matching row is a degenerate to_factor = 1.0 control that matches trivially. The reference environment for that corpus is Excel 16.0 build 20131, stated once for the whole pass and not restated on the G4-05 row. Beyond that, a candidate op-graph (value * Cfrom / Cto with extended >53-bit factors) scores 1 of 1 non-trivial witness, and both the lane survey and the dive plan label that score an overfit risk in the same sentence: it has not been held-out-validated across the other 91 same-category unit pairs. The lane was then recorded as blocked with no effort spent, because CONVERT needs text-argument plumbing that does not exist.
